# re:verse DS

> An AI-ready mobile banking design system in Figma (file qUknPCIey4DG3PH19e1OmD). Agents assemble screens from local components and variables, following the rules and recipes below.

## Start here
- [Agent rules](CLAUDE.md): hard rules and the build workflow
- [Figma ledger](state/figma-ledger.json): page, collection and component ids

## Foundations
- [Tokens](foundations/tokens.md): collections, naming, scopes, which token for which role
- [Theming](foundations/theming.md): brand themes, light/dark, radii
- [Typography](foundations/typography.md): text styles and when to use them
- [Voice](foundations/voice.md): UI copy and Spirit tone of voice

## Components
- [Catalog](components/overview.md): every component, its synonyms and the file to read

## Recipes
- [Recipes index](recipes/overview.md): screen recipes (home, account, transfer, sheet, goal, budget, chat answer)

## Scenarios
- [Scenarios index](scenarios/overview.md): multi-screen flows from a brief

## Optional
- [Evals](evals/rubric.md): how an agent's screen is scored
- [Research](research/ai-ready-ds-research.md): how AI-ready design systems work (Russian)
